Name: Woolly Bison
Author: ArrynHellfire
Description:
The Bison can be purchased from Marnie after building a Big Barn. Produces Milk every day like a regular cow but it will also shed wool once a week when the friendship is high enough (at the same time as when it starts producing Large Milk). 

Sprites made by me, Baby Bison is mostly a recolour of the baby cow with some adjustments.

Manifest.Description: Adds a Woolly Bison that can be milked and drops wool sometimes
